questions.text: What did you dream about when you were a child?

Write down people you know. Those are your assets in terms of your connections. Your closest circle is you, then your partner, then family, then friends, then colleagues, then people you know. Look at each circle. Don't think about it just do it. Select people that can be helpful to you. Maybe they have a business, maybe they can hire you.
